# HandCut

> HandCut is a captions-first iPhone video editor. It transcribes speech on the device into word-by-word captions and never adds a watermark. No account, no ads. Edit free; exporting needs HandCut Pro, a monthly subscription priced in the app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762062166

## What it does
- Word-by-word (karaoke) captions timed from the audio; edit any word, restyle, reposition
- Burn captions into the video, or export an SRT file
- Picture-in-picture: screen recording + facecam bubble + captions
- Multi-clip timeline, 14 transitions, speed 0.25x-4x, text/emoji/images, music and voiceover mixer, manual keyframes, reframe to vertical, square or widescreen, export up to 4K at up to 60 fps

## Free and Pro
- Downloading and editing are free. Exporting needs HandCut Pro, a monthly subscription; the App Store price for each country is shown in the app before purchase.
- Pro also includes transcript editing (delete words to cut video), motion tracking, Smart Cutout, Auto-Reframe, denoise, Auto Match Look and version history.
- No watermark on any export. Existing purchases can be restored.

## Good fit for
People who talk to camera: coaches, course creators, realtors, podcasters, product sellers.

## Limits
- iPhone only (iOS 17+); no Android, web or desktop
- Caption languages are the ones the iPhone recognises offline (listed on the export screen); English is the most tested
